line_items.reasoning: Q4 revenue was guided to grow 'up slightly,' but NIKE Digital declined 10%, lifestyle business declined, and FY25 revenue was cut dramatically to down mid-single digits vs. prior guidance of down low single digits in H1 only — signaling Q4 revenue momentum fell well short of expectations.
Q4 gross margin expanded only 110 bps to 44.7%, falling short of the guided 160–180 bps expansion range.

Q4 diluted EPS of $0.99 was up 50% versus prior year and full-year EPS grew 15%, suggesting earnings came in well ahead of the reaffirmed full-year outlook, aided by cost savings and restructuring benefits.

FY25 revenue is now expected to be down mid-single digits with Q1 alone down ~10%, a significant deterioration versus the prior guidance of H1 FY25 down only low single digits, driven by worse-than-expected franchise lifecycle headwinds and digital softness.
